title: Practice 3: Verbs that take the genitive

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.why: The object is in the accusative case if animate and in the genitive case if inanimate: *Я жду жену. Я жду письма.* — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book. Lessons 27, 66.  ·  «The person or thing feared is in the Genitive case: Я боюсь этого человека.» «The object (of ждать) is in the accusative case if animate and in the genitive case if inanimate.» — DLI, Lessons 27, 66.
